title: Conditional κ = 0.001636461592777116: attain the fixed-dispatch packing ceiling
body:
Improves conditional **κ from 0.001636456810414854 (PR638) to 0.001636461592777116**, a gain of **0.000000004782362262**. Comparison is pinned to PR638 head `a77f4a358b5129cda3e510a11a7f9a818aba5274`.

Three width swaps combine the residual idle ranks 1 and 35 into a single rank 36, leaving 2229 ranks of 48. Ten serialized owner rows change, including interval compaction. Suppliers, helper widths, 71-JP8/1-CK dispatch, geometry, and admission code remain unchanged.

This realizes the minimum idle moment for these **fixed suppliers, dispatch, geometry and capacity limits**. Total unused capacity is 107028=2229·48+36; concavity of x^(1−q), for 0 < q < 1, shows concentration at 48 with at most one remainder minimizes the idle moment. The literal map attains that relaxation. This is fixed-input moment-packing optimality, not universal κ optimality or a claim that the rounded decimal equals the exact root.

Includes a portable witness with pinned dependencies, two deterministic owner reconstructions, the packing proof, and exact prepublication receipts. Jeremy Kothe and the contributors retained in PR637 supplied the native construction; PR638 supplied the starting assignment.

Validation before publication:
- Exact bindings, physical owner admission and 23 mutations, finite invoice, and both moment engines pass.
- Independent recount of all 35,424 roles, actual native widths/profiles, and strict rational moment passes; five corruptions reject.
- Both deterministic owner reconstructions pass under ordinary and optimized Python; four exporter corruption controls reject.

**The full fresh replay now passes 64/64 stages without reuse**, in296.15seconds. All51 artifact hashes and64 stage-log hashes were independently verified. Supplemental native/owner/rational checks, five owner mutations, declarations, both exact owner reconstructions, four exporter mutations and six U4 mutations pass. Full evidence and the replay archive are in `research/pr638-improvement-20261013/validation/`. Execution was on macOS; no Linux replay is claimed.

The inherited compiler, all-size, realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, analytic-transfer, and bit H1–H5 assumptions remain. This is a conditional research bound. The selected main certificate is unchanged.

Prepared by Chi Zhao with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
